A clean alternative to the usual button-down, this men's black linen cotton shirt is made from 55% linen and 45% cotton in a solid woven finish. The regular fit gives it an easy shape for casual days, while the black colour keeps the look understated.

A band collar, half sleeves and a pull-on opening with button detail set this style apart. The no-pocket front keeps the silhouette uncluttered, and the rounded hem works especially well when worn untucked.

Product highlights
- 55% linen and 45% cotton solid woven fabric
- Regular fit
- Band collar and half sleeves
- Pull-on opening with button detail
- No-pocket front and round hem

Styling note
Pair it with stone chinos for contrast or wear it with black trousers for a tonal look.

Care
Machine wash cold. Wash dark colours separately. Do not bleach. Remove promptly and dry in the shade.
